title: Card-Funded Reservation Deposits at a Homesite Reservation Extension
content:
For a Homesite Reservation hold extension, the extension card shortening is read from how the reservation deposit was paid, counting only the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component reservation deposit.

**Decision lines.**

- Card payments make up the whole reservation deposit received: the extension card shortening is **2** days.
- Card payments make up part but not all of it: **1** day.
- No part of it was paid by card: zero.

## Cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Reservation deposit payments | Shortening |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 by card | 2 days |
| 500.00 by card, 1000.00 by check | 1 day |
| 7500.00 by wire | zero |
| 2500.00 by ACH, premium holding fee 500.00 by card | zero (only the reservation deposit is read) |

Card convenience fee entries are their own component and are not reservation deposit payments.
